JinkoSolar Holding Co., Ltd. (NYSE:JKS)’s share price dropped 5.6% during mid-day trading on Tuesday . The company traded as low as $11.92 and last traded at $12.16. Approximately 987,700 shares traded hands during trading, an increase of 50% from the average daily volume of 659,992 shares. The stock had previously closed at $12.88.
JKS has been the topic of a number of research reports. Zacks Investment Research lowered JinkoSolar from a “strong-buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Thursday, May 31st. UBS Group initiated coverage on JinkoSolar in a report on Friday, March 16th. They set a “buy” rating and a $26.00 price target on the stock. ValuEngine lowered JinkoSolar from a “sell” rating to a “strong sell” rating in a report on Tuesday, June 5th. Goldman Sachs Group lowered JinkoSolar to a “sell” rating in a report on Wednesday, June 6th. Finally, Credit Suisse Group lowered their price target on JinkoSolar from $22.00 to $13.00 and set a “neutral” rating on the stock in a report on Thursday, June 7th. Seven research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, one has assigned a hold rating and one has given a buy rating to the company’s stock. JinkoSolar currently has a consensus rating of “Sell” and a consensus target price of $16.17.

The firm has a market cap of $347.78 million, a price-to-earnings ratio of 17.88, a P/E/G ratio of 1.65 and a beta of 1.86. The company has a quick ratio of 0.77, a current ratio of 0.98 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.18.
JinkoSolar (NYSE:JKS) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, March 22nd. The semiconductor company reported $0.12 earnings per share for the quarter, missing the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $0.23 by ($0.11). JinkoSolar had a net margin of 0.53% and a return on equity of 2.12%. The business had revenue of $976.40 million during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $971.40 million. During the same period in the prior year, the firm posted $1.04 EPS. JinkoSolar’s revenue for the quarter was up 32.4% compared to the same quarter last year. analysts predict that JinkoSolar Holding Co., Ltd. will post 0.74 earnings per share for the current year.

About JinkoSolar
JinkoSolar Holding Co, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, development, production, and marketing of photovoltaic products in the People's Republic of China and internationally.
